reading_rule: Each row is one sheet field; its terms are the oracle tokens that feed it, summed. A term names its token, the .lst (under the corpus starfinder/ directory) and record that carry it, and a shape the evaluator (codex-ingest sheet_rule::sf_mapping) knows. A shape the evaluator does not know, a token missing from its carrier, or an unresolved choice is refused by name. Every oracle observation is a value a real PCGen run printed for a named build (oracle-builds/<build>.oracle.txt, re-run by oracle-builds/run_oracle_builds.sh).

oracle_builds.sf_mechanic: $PCGEN_REPO_DIR/code/testsuite/PCGfiles/sf_mechanic.pcg (PCGen's own test character: ysoki mechanic 20, Toughness)
oracle_builds.sf_mechanic_drone: $PCGEN_REPO_DIR/code/testsuite/PCGfiles/sf_mechanic_drone.pcg (PCGen's own test drone R2-D2, stealth chassis, master sf_mechanic.pcg), run in PCGen's party batch-export mode with its master loaded: oracle-builds/run_drone_party.sh (SD-37 E5.4; a single-character run prints DroneLVL 0, hp 0, because MASTERVAR needs the master)

rows.pf_reading: PF reads BONUS:HP|CURRENTMAX as a bonus to the one hit-point total and HD as a die rolled per level; it has no RaceHP and reads BONUS:HP|ALTHP as a second hit-point figure. Read that way, a reader that adds ALTHP into HP, or swaps the two pools, prints per-level-plausible numbers with Con and race HP in the wrong total.

terms.note: Soldier 6, Envoy 5, Mystic 5, Mechanic 5, Technomancer 4 per level: one less than the SRD class Hit Points, the HD die makes up the 1
HD:1 on every player class: a d1, one point per level (the .pcg stores HITPOINTS:1 per level)
RaceHP is set by BONUS:VAR|RaceHP|<n> on '<race> Race Selection ~ Default' (Human/Lashunta/Android 4, Ysoki 2)

the drone's Hit Points (a companion, never a player build: 0 for every player class). DroneLVL is the master's DroneCompanionLVL through the companion modifier (scr_companionmods.lst:13); the engine evaluates it on the drone's own held set (sf_drone_print.rs). With the class's -1 (row hit_die_offset) cancelling its one HD:1 level, HP = 10 x DroneLVL (+10 at 18, 19, 20) = the SRD table

srd.section: Calculating Hit Points: racial Hit Points at 1st level + class Hit Points each level
Drone base statistics table, Hit Points column: 10 per class level 1-17 (1st 10, 10th 100, 17th 170), 18th 190, 19th 210, 20th 230 (Core Rulebook p. 72; fetched 2026-10-05, E5.4)

rows.sheet_field: (no printed line) the drone class's -1 against its one HD:1 class level
rows.pf_reading: PF has no drone; read as a PF bonus, BONUS:HP|CURRENTMAX|-1 would print a -1 hit-point line that, without the d1 die it cancels, leaves the drone one short of the SRD table

terms.note: the drone race holds one Drone class level (MONSTERCLASS:Drone:1, scr_races.lst:20); its HD:1 adds 1 (the .pcg stores HITPOINTS:1) and this -1 removes it. The converter prints neither: the drone's hit points are the drone_hp_progression term alone

srd.section: Drone base statistics table, Hit Points column: 10 per class level 1-17 (1st 10, 10th 100, 17th 170), 18th 190, 19th 210, 20th 230 (Core Rulebook p. 72; fetched 2026-10-05, E5.4)

rows.pf_reading: PF has no Stamina; BONUS:HP|ALTHP read through the PF mapping is an alternate hit-point figure, and Con-to-hit-points (PF's per-level Con bonus) would put CON*TL into Hit Points.

terms.note: Soldier 7, Envoy 6, Mystic 6, Mechanic 6, Technomancer 5: equal to the SRD class Stamina Points

srd.section: Calculating Stamina Points: class Stamina Points + Constitution modifier each level
Benefit: 1 Stamina Point for every character level

rows.pf_reading: PF reads every BONUS:COMBAT|AC as one Armor Class and prints AC.Total, which here sums EAC_Armor and KAC_Armor: the six runs print AC.Total 24/20/24/18/49/28 against EAC 16/16/18/14/30/21.

srd.section: Armor Class: EAC = 10 + armor's EAC bonus + Dex modifier

rows.pf_reading: As eac: the PF reading prints AC.Total (EAC_Armor + KAC_Armor + Dex + 10), not KAC.

srd.section: Armor Class: KAC = 10 + armor's KAC bonus + Dex modifier

rows.pf_reading: PF has no key ability; FACT is a free-text fact, so a PF reader prints the string ('Str or Dex') and cannot resolve the choice forms the Resolve total depends on.

terms.note: fixed (CHA, WIS, INT, DEX, CON) or choice ('Str or Dex' Soldier; 'INT or WIS' Biohacker, COM); the choice comes from the build ('Soldier Key Ability ~ STR' in the .pcg)

rows.pf_reading: PF has no Resolve; the PF mapping reads BONUS:VAR|Resolve as an opaque variable contribution with no sheet line.

terms.note: with BONUS:VAR|Resolve_PCLvl|max(1,EffectiveLVL/2): max(1, max(1, level/2) + key modifier). The SRD has no outer max(1, …); the two differ only when the key modifier makes the sum < 1

srd.section: Calculating Resolve Points: half character level (minimum 1) + key ability modifier

refusals.why: a drone has no Stamina Points (SRD drone base statistics: 'Drones do not have Stamina Points'); Energy Shield is a level-11 mod whose shield points no drone build observed by the oracle holds, so it is named here, not mapped (SD-37 E5.4)
no seed or PCGen test character holds it; it feeds hit_points by its token but has no oracle observation, so it is named here, not mapped
no Starfinder player class has one; a rolled die is refused by the evaluator
